subject: Quick follow-up — conference chat about inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up — conference chat about inference needs

Hi Samir —

Great meeting you at the Inference Summit last week — I enjoyed our conversation about where FinLytics is headed with real-time scoring and lower-latency embeddings. A quick recap from our side so we can align on next steps: 

- Primary goal: reduce per-request latency for our ML scoring pipeline (current SLA target: p95 < 200ms) while cutting unit cost on embeddings workloads.
- Constraints: data residency for EU customers is coming up in Q2; SOC 2 & audit logs are a must for procurement.
- Preferred deployment: exploring a dedicated/reserved pool for predictable throughput, but open to a private VPC deployment if compliance requires it.

Attached is a short deck I promised with: throughput/latency benchmarks, pricing tiers (hosted vs dedicated), and a sample mutual action plan.

Next suggested steps:
1) 30-min technical sync (we can include one of our infra engineers) — propose Tue 11/09 or Wed 11/10 10–11am PT.
2) I’ll share a concise compliance checklist (SOC 2 evidence, data retention, KMS options) before the call.

If you prefer, reply with the best time and any teammates you want looped in.

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-deck-conference-2026.pdf (slides, 8 pages)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finlytics.io>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — conference chat about inference needs

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the deck — useful overview. Quick answers from my side:
- We're definitely interested in reducing p95 latency and lowering embedding/unit cost — that's a top priority for our product team.
- I need to run the compliance asks by our security lead (Anita) — I should have clarity by early next week.

I can do Tue 11/09 at 10am PT for a technical sync — please send a calendar invite with who from your side will join. Also, can you include a ballpark of committed vs burst pricing for Dedicated? That will help me prep.

Samir
Head of Infrastructure
FinLytics
samir.patel@finlytics.io

Hi Samir —

Wanted to send one more quick nudge — did you get a chance to confirm timing with Anita and the product team? If now isn't a priority, totally understood — could you let me know whether this is: 

- Still a priority in the next 30 days
- Pushed to next quarter
- Not a fit right now

If it's still on, Dylan (cc'd) and I can do a short 30-min call this week — Thu 11/21 9–10am PT or Fri 11/22 11am–12pm PT. If neither works, share a week that does and we'll accommodate.

Also attaching a single-page committed vs burst pricing summary and the compliance checklist you asked about.

Thanks for the quick update — even a one-line reply helps us prioritize.
